whatWeDo.heading: End-to-End
whatWeDo.description: From hardware design to cloud platforms, we cover every layer of the industrial IoT stack — built in Bangalore, deployed globally.

features.title: Telecom Tower OA
features.description: Remote monitoring of passive infrastructure — batteries, rectifiers, generators, fuel levels, security, and environmental sensors — all in one platform.

features.title: Solar & Energy Monitoring
features.description: Solar monitoring solutions with integrated energy measurement and billing. Real-time visibility over renewable assets from edge to cloud.

features.title: Digital Energy Meters
features.description: Smart tariff-grade meters, multi-function meters, and GSM energy meters for utility billing and consumption analytics.

features.title: Industrial Networking — SILBO
features.description: Industrial routers, SD-WAN gateways, protocol converters, and network switches designed for harsh industrial environments.

features.title: PizGloria RMS Platform
features.description: Cloud-based Remote Monitoring System with graphical dashboards, Power BI analytics, mobile app, and automated alerting.

features.title: OEM / ODM & Design Services
features.description: Bespoke hardware design, product development, and 24×7 remote support services for OEM and ODM customers worldwide.

stats.label: Years of successful operations in IIoT

items.name: Shyam Iyer
items.quote: ATC India is using Invendis to monitor tower operations across ~70,000+ towers. Invendis has provided trouble-ticketing, mobile-based field interface, and real-time alarm monitoring — aiding field efficiency.

items.name: Alexander Pigall
items.quote: I feel Invendis is a company that listens and does all they can to meet my needs. There is open, honest communication on all levels and a process to improve where things fail. Transparency is key.

items.name: Hans Moritz
items.quote: Our enterprise system combines Asset Management (ERP), WO & TT System, RMS (Invendis), and Electronic Key System. Invendis RMS auto-generates trouble tickets with alarms to manage all end-to-end processes.
